commodity_bar_meaning.explanation: This bar chart displays the total export revenue and volume distribution across major 4-digit agricultural commodity chapters.
commodity_bar_meaning.key_takeaway: Cashew Nuts (HS 0801) serves as the primary export revenue engine, generating 74.3% of total agricultural trade value ($624.4M USD).
commodity_bar_meaning.action: Prioritize targeted fiscal incentives and industrial zone infrastructure for domestic value-addition processing.

country_donut_meaning.explanation: This donut chart visualizes export market concentration across international destination countries.
country_donut_meaning.key_takeaway: Market concentration score (HHI = 7,150) reflects elevated concentration risk, with វៀតណាម serving as the lead buyer.
country_donut_meaning.action: Establish direct bilateral trade agreements and cold-chain shipping corridors to diversify into high-value consumer markets.

price_jump_meaning.explanation: This side-by-side comparison illustrates the unit export price difference between raw commodities and processed products.
price_jump_meaning.key_takeaway: Processing raw commodities (such as shelling raw cashews or processing spices) unlocks a 2.4x to 5.0x increase in unit export value.
price_jump_meaning.action: Incentivize local agro-processing factories to capture higher value domestically rather than exporting raw unprocessed crops.

seasonality_line_meaning.explanation: This dual-axis line chart tracks monthly export volume (tonnes) against export revenue ($USD) across the trade timeline.
seasonality_line_meaning.key_takeaway: Peak export volumes surge during the Q1 harvest cycle (February to April), followed by lower seasonal export volumes in Q3.
seasonality_line_meaning.action: Expand post-harvest cold-storage and warehouse warrant systems to stagger supply and capture premium off-season unit prices.

executive_strategy: Accelerate domestic agro-processing capacity for Cashew Nuts (HS 0801) to retain the 5.0x processing value multiplier domestically.
Diversify international trade destinations beyond វៀតណាម by securing direct phytosanitary trade protocols with regional and global markets.
Invest in temperature-controlled warehousing and logistical infrastructure to smooth out post-harvest price volatility.
